#layer3 heatmap
```{r}
# module heatmap: time-point number benchmark

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(Matrix)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

# Step 0. IO

out_dir <- "/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/Benchmark/benchmark_timepoint_number_4000g_20000c"

obj_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "sim_objects")
phase_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "res_phase")
param_wide_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "param_wide")
module_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "res_module")
module_result_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "module_result")
heatmap_obj_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "module_heatmap_objects")
heatmap_plot_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "plots_module_heatmap")
index_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "index")

dir.create(module_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(module_result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(heatmap_obj_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(heatmap_plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(index_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

timepoint_vec <- c(24, 12, 8, 6, 4, 2)
n_repeat <- 1

compare_by <- "condition"
group1 <- "cond_1"
group2 <- "cond_2"
module_ids <- 0:7

force_rerun_module_heatmap <- TRUE

expected_zt_list <- list(
  "24" = seq(0, 23, by = 1),
  "12" = seq(0, 22, by = 2),
  "8"  = seq(0, 21, by = 3),
  "6"  = seq(0, 20, by = 4),
  "4"  = seq(0, 18, by = 6),
  "2"  = c(4, 12)
)

if (force_rerun_module_heatmap) {
  unlink(module_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
  unlink(module_result_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
  unlink(heatmap_obj_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
  unlink(heatmap_plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
  dir.create(module_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(module_result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(heatmap_obj_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(heatmap_plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

# Step 1. Run module inference and heatmap plotting

module_record_all <- list()
run_id <- 1

for (n_timepoint in timepoint_vec) {
  for (rep_id in seq_len(n_repeat)) {
    message("============================================================")
    message("Running module heatmap | n_timepoint = ", n_timepoint, " | repeat = ", rep_id)
    
    obj_file <- file.path(
      obj_dir,
      paste0("simulate_data_timepoint", n_timepoint, "_4000g_20000c.rds")
    )
    
    phase_file <- file.path(
      phase_dir,
      paste0("res_phase_timepoint", n_timepoint, "_rep", rep_id, ".rds")
    )
    
    param_wide_file <- file.path(
      param_wide_dir,
      paste0("param_wide_timepoint", n_timepoint, "_rep", rep_id, ".rds")
    )
    
    file_tag <- paste0(
      "timepoint", n_timepoint,
      "_rep", rep_id,
      "_", compare_by,
      "_", group1, "_vs_", group2
    )
    
    module_file <- file.path(
      module_dir,
      paste0("res_module_", file_tag, ".rds")
    )
    
    module_result_csv <- file.path(
      module_result_dir,
      paste0("module_result_", file_tag, ".csv")
    )
    
    module_result_rds <- file.path(
      module_result_dir,
      paste0("module_result_", file_tag, ".rds")
    )
    
    heatmap_obj_file <- file.path(
      heatmap_obj_dir,
      paste0("hm_module_", file_tag, ".rds")
    )
    
    plot_subdir <- file.path(
      heatmap_plot_dir,
      file_tag
    )
    
    dir.create(plot_subdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    
    stopifnot(
      file.exists(obj_file),
      file.exists(phase_file),
      file.exists(param_wide_file)
    )
    
    obj_sim <- readRDS(obj_file)
    DefaultAssay(obj_sim) <- "RNA"
    
    count <- Seurat::GetAssayData(
      obj_sim,
      assay = "RNA",
      slot = "counts"
    )
    
    metadata <- obj_sim@meta.data %>%
      as.data.frame()
    metadata$cell <- rownames(metadata)
    metadata$condition <- as.character(metadata$condition)
    metadata$group <- as.character(metadata$group)
    metadata$celltype <- as.character(metadata$celltype)
    
    res_phase <- readRDS(phase_file) %>%
      mutate(cell = as.character(cell))
    
    res_phase <- res_phase[match(metadata$cell, res_phase$cell), , drop = FALSE]
    
    param_wide <- readRDS(param_wide_file)
    
    zt_observed <- sort(unique(as.numeric(metadata$ZT_sym)))
    zt_expected <- expected_zt_list[[as.character(n_timepoint)]]
    
    stopifnot(
      nrow(count) == 4000,
      ncol(count) == 20000,
      identical(colnames(count), metadata$cell),
      identical(res_phase$cell, metadata$cell),
      all(c("cell", "theta_pred", "ZT_pred", "r_cell", "Rbar") %in% colnames(res_phase)),
      all(c("ZT_sym", "ZT_true", "condition", "group", "celltype") %in% colnames(metadata)),
      all(is.finite(res_phase$theta_pred)),
      all(is.finite(res_phase$r_cell)),
      identical(zt_observed, zt_expected),
      length(unique(metadata$celltype)) == 1,
      all(unique(metadata$celltype) == "Celltype1"),
      all(sort(unique(metadata$condition)) == c(group1, group2))
    )
    
    message("Object dimension:")
    print(dim(count))
    
    message("Condition table:")
    print(table(metadata$condition))
    
    message("Celltype table:")
    print(table(metadata$celltype))
    
    message("Observed ZT points: ", paste(zt_observed, collapse = ", "))
    message("Expected ZT points: ", paste(zt_expected, collapse = ", "))
    
    message("Median r_cell: ", round(median(res_phase$r_cell, na.rm = TRUE), 4))
    message("Median Rbar: ", round(median(res_phase$Rbar, na.rm = TRUE), 4))
    
    res_module <- infer_rhythm_module(
      param_wide = param_wide,
      compare_by = compare_by,
      group1 = group1,
      group2 = group2,
      out_dir = NULL,
      Verbose = TRUE
    )
    
    res_module$benchmark <- list(
      benchmark = "timepoint_number",
      n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
      repeat_id = rep_id,
      compare_by = compare_by,
      group1 = group1,
      group2 = group2,
      gene_number = 4000,
      cell_number = 20000,
      n_condition = 2,
      n_celltype = 1
    )
    
    res_module$module_result <- res_module$module_result %>%
      mutate(
        n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
        repeat_id = rep_id,
        benchmark = "timepoint_number",
        compare_by = compare_by,
        group1 = group1,
        group2 = group2
      )
    
    saveRDS(res_module, module_file)
    write_csv(res_module$module_result, module_result_csv)
    saveRDS(res_module$module_result, module_result_rds)
    
    message("Module counts:")
    print(table(res_module$module_result$module_map, useNA = "ifany"))
    
    hm_module <- plot_module_heatmap(
      count = count,
      res_phase = res_phase,
      gene_meta = res_module$module_result,
      metadata = metadata,
      group_by = compare_by,
      group1 = group1,
      group2 = group2
    )
    
    saveRDS(hm_module, heatmap_obj_file)
    
    for (module_id_i in module_ids) {
      message("Plotting M", module_id_i, " | n_timepoint = ", n_timepoint)
      
      pdf_file <- file.path(
        plot_subdir,
        paste0("timepoint", n_timepoint, "_rep", rep_id, "_module", module_id_i, "_heatmap.pdf")
      )
      
      png_file <- file.path(
        plot_subdir,
        paste0("timepoint", n_timepoint, "_rep", rep_id, "_module", module_id_i, "_heatmap.png")
      )
      
      pdf(pdf_file, width = 7, height = 4.8)
      plot(hm_module, module_id = module_id_i, title = paste0("M", module_id_i))
      dev.off()
      
      png(png_file, width = 7, height = 4.8, units = "in", res = 300)
      plot(hm_module, module_id = module_id_i, title = paste0("M", module_id_i))
      dev.off()
    }
    
    module_record_all[[run_id]] <- tibble(
      n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
      repeat_id = rep_id,
      compare_by = compare_by,
      group1 = group1,
      group2 = group2,
      ZT_points = paste(zt_expected, collapse = ","),
      object_file = obj_file,
      res_phase_file = phase_file,
      param_wide_file = param_wide_file,
      res_module_file = module_file,
      module_result_csv = module_result_csv,
      module_result_rds = module_result_rds,
      heatmap_object_file = heatmap_obj_file,
      heatmap_plot_dir = plot_subdir,
      object_exists = file.exists(obj_file),
      phase_exists = file.exists(phase_file),
      param_wide_exists = file.exists(param_wide_file),
      module_exists = file.exists(module_file),
      heatmap_object_exists = file.exists(heatmap_obj_file),
      status = "finished_new"
    )
    
    write_csv(
      bind_rows(module_record_all),
      file.path(index_dir, "timepoint_module_heatmap_file_index.csv")
    )
    
    run_id <- run_id + 1
    
    rm(obj_sim, count, metadata, res_phase, param_wide, res_module, hm_module)
    gc()
  }
}

# Step 2. Save index

module_index <- bind_rows(module_record_all) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_timepoint), repeat_id)

write_csv(
  module_index,
  file.path(index_dir, "timepoint_module_heatmap_file_index.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  module_index,
  file.path(index_dir, "timepoint_module_heatmap_file_index.rds")
)

print(module_index)

message("Finished time-point number module heatmap benchmark.")
message("Module results: ", module_dir)
message("Heatmap objects: ", heatmap_obj_dir)
message("Heatmap plots: ", heatmap_plot_dir)
```
